title: Bath & Body Works 3 Wick Candle – Midnight Blue Citrus 🕯️ Fresh Clean Citrus Candle for Home | Long Lasting Aroma | BBW Original
description:
Bath & Body Works 3 Wick Candle – Midnight Blue Citrus Fresh Clean Citrus Candle for Home | Long Lasting Aroma | BBW Original

Light it. Feel it. Love it.
Transform your home instantly with the Bath & Body Works Midnight Blue Citrus 3-Wick Candle — a fresh, sparkling, and luxurious scent that turns any space into a 5-star hotel mood.

SCENT NOTES

Juicy Citrus • Sparkling Spring Water • Sweet Mango

Balanced with a smooth, relaxing clean finish — perfect for any mood

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

3-Wick Design for stronger, even scent throw

⏳ Burns up to 45 hours – long-lasting and worth every cent

Fills the whole room in minutes – ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, or workspace

Made with Natural Essential Oils for a premium, soothing experience

Perfect Gift Idea for birthdays, housewarmings, anniversaries & self-care moments

HOW TO USE:
Simply light all 3 wicks and let the calming citrus blend melt away stress & lift your mood.

Imported & 100% Original from Bath & Body Works USA.
